metadata.name: Authenticity Scorer
metadata.description: Analyzes text for AI fingerprints and authenticity markers, returning a score from 0-100
metadata.author: Adrian Goldner

input.name: text
input.description: The text content to analyze for authenticity

input.name: tone_of_voice_guide
input.description: Optional: User's tone-of-voice guide for reference

output.name: detailed_report
output.description: Detailed breakdown with identified issues and positive markers

step.action: Load the text to analyze from the input parameter

step.details: - Start with base score of 70 points - AI fingerprints will subtract points - Authenticity markers will add points - Final score capped at 0-100

step.action: Scan for AI FINGERPRINTS (each occurrence = -5 points)

ai-fingerprint.patterns: - "Es geht nicht um X, sondern um Y" - "Nicht X ist wichtig, sondern Y" - "Vergiss X, konzentrier dich auf Y"
- Excessive use of three-item lists - "X, Y, und Z" in every paragraph - Forced triadic structures
- "Die brutale Wahrheit?" - "Hier ist die Realität:" - "Das Geheimnis ist..." - "Lass mich dir etwas verraten..."
- "implementieren", "optimieren", "skalieren" - "ganzheitlich", "nachhaltig", "innovativ" - "maximieren", "transformieren" - Excessive use of abstract nouns ending in -ierung
- "Es ist wichtig zu erwähnen..." - "Grundsätzlich gilt..." - "Letztendlich hängt es davon ab..." - "In der Regel..."
- "revolutionär", "bahnbrechend", "game-changing" - "ultimativ", "perfekt", "unglaublich" - Excessive exclamation marks (more than 1 per 300 words)
- "Die Reise beginnt..." - "Tauchen wir ein in..." - "Entdecke die Welt von..." - "Öffne die Tür zu..."
- More than 3 rhetorical questions per 500 words - Questions followed immediately by answers - "Warum? Weil..." pattern repetition

step.action: Scan for AUTHENTICITY MARKERS (each occurrence = +5 points)

authenticity-marker.patterns: - First-person stories with specific details - "Neulich hatte ich..." / "Letzte Woche passierte..." - Specific names, places, dates - Vulnerability and personal failure stories
- "Früher dachte ich... Heute weiß ich..." - "Anfangs habe ich... Mittlerweile..." - Evolution of thinking over time - Admission of changed opinions
- Questions left unanswered for reader reflection - "Wie sieht es bei dir aus?" - Genuine curiosity without immediate answer
- "vielleicht", "irgendwie", "glaube ich" - "merk ich grad", "kann sein" - Informal language and contractions - Regional dialect touches
- Concrete numbers, dates, locations - Named tools, books, people - Specific prices, metrics, results - Real client/project examples (anonymized)
- Going against mainstream advice - "Unpopular opinion:" - Challenging conventional wisdom - Nuanced take on controversial topics
- Self-deprecating humor - Playful language and puns - Pop culture references - Emojis used naturally (not forced)
- Sentence fragments for emphasis - "Und weißt du was?" - Parenthetical asides (like this one) - Conversational interruptions

step.formula: final_score = base_score(70) - total_ai_penalties + total_authenticity_rewards final_score = CLAMP(final_score, 0, 100)

step.action: Generate detailed report in markdown format
step.template:
# Authenticity Score Report
**Final Score:** {score}/100
## Score Interpretation
- 0-50: Stark AI-generiert - Deutliche AI-Fingerprints erkennbar - 51-70: Moderate AI-Fingerprints - Authentizität verbessern - 71-85: Gut authentisch - Minimale AI-Spuren - 86-100: Exzellent authentisch - Natürliche menschliche Stimme
---
## 🚨 AI Fingerprints Gefunden ({total_ai_fingerprints})
{list_each_ai_fingerprint_with_quote_and_penalty}
**Total AI Penalty:** -{total_penalty} points
---
## ✅ Authentizität Markers Gefunden ({total_authenticity_markers})
{list_each_authenticity_marker_with_quote_and_reward}
**Total Authenticity Bonus:** +{total_bonus} points
---
## 📊 Scoring Breakdown
- Base Score: 70 - AI Penalties: -{total_penalty} - Authenticity Bonus: +{total_bonus} - **Final Score: {final_score}/100**
---
## 💡 Empfehlungen
{if score < 71: - Entferne identifizierte AI-Fingerprints - Füge mehr persönliche Anekdoten hinzu - Verwende spezifischere Beispiele - Lockere die Sprache auf (Weichmacher, Umgangssprache) }
{if score >= 71: - Score ist akzeptabel für Publishing - Optional: Weitere Authentizität durch persönliche Stories }

usage-example.scenario: Validate a draft newsletter article before publishing

task.notes: - The base score of 70 assumes neutral text - Adjust thresholds in config.yaml (authenticity_min_score) - This task can be invoked by the Quality-Validator agent - Run this BEFORE publishing any content
